shipped_floor.source: judge_noise2.json, same arm (r5_k3, dc=rphi, 2-step, merged Stage-1, no adapter), seeds 101/202/303 over the full 96 held-out clips

legacy_4step_floor.source: judge_seeds.json, same arm (r6_xl_k3, dc=rphi, 4-step, merged Stage-1), seeds 101/202/303 over the full 96 held-out clips

noise_floor.rule: a delta below 2 x lpips_sd is not interpretable; use the floor that matches the step count the arms were sampled at, and say which one was used

main.note: dck3 = R_phi r5_k3 (4.7M, K=3); dcxl = r6_xl_k3 (13.3M, K=3). The width step between them is +0.0020 LPIPS, 1.1 noise floors, so it is NOT established -- the shipped configuration should be the 4.7M one. The headline LPIPS is the three-seed mean 0.1980 +- 0.0018, not the seed-101 draw of 0.1964.

steps.shipped: R_phi r5_k3 (4.7M, K=3), 2 steps via turbo_sigmas(2, 12.0), innerDC onto R_phi(y), no quota gate, no third-party adapter
steps.two_step_floor_measured: sd 0.0009 over seeds 101/202/303 at 2 steps, half the 4-step floor. The -0.0056 is 6.3 of these, not 3.1 of the 4-step ones.

ablation.note: 2x2 over innerDC target x quota gate. The gate is a net regression on held-out data (LPIPS +0.0085 = 4.7 noise floors, terr_null worse on 67 of 71 clips) and was dropped; its gain was tuned on the 24-clip const set and reversed on the 96-clip held-out set.

omni.note: single = r5_big, omni = omni_m4; matched on width (4.73 vs 4.76M), windows (10351), iters (24000), crop (112) and K (1 -- OmniRange has no causal stack). The x2 and x8 held-out sets use the same 96 clips as x4 with byte-identical HR frames.

negative.why: lpips +0.0443 (25 noise floors), 6/77 clips better, and lpips_gtrange +0.0496 -- it degrades the generated detail itself. A strength sweep at 0.25/0.50/1.00 degrades monotonically from zero, so the scale assumption was right and the direction is wrong for degraded camera footage.

lpips +0.0518 at its own 2 steps and +0.0933 at 4 steps, with lpips_gtrange 0.1368 -> 0.2043 / 0.2482. Together with the Open-H3 refiner (+0.0443 lpips, +0.0496 gtrange) this is two independent third-party H3 adapters failing in the same band: both were distilled on H3's own generation distribution, not on a restoration pipeline with a guide latent and an innerDC projection. Reducing the step count WITHOUT an adapter is fine and in fact better -- see the steps section.

negative.what: post-hoc range substitution on other methods
negative.why: lpips +0.0132 on FlashVSR+ and +0.0031 on InfVSR: the substitution buys PSNR and temporal error, not perceptual quality. lpips_gtrange moves +0.0004, which is the correctness check -- that metric replaces the range with truth, so substituting the range should not move it.

public_benchmark.note: Vid4 is out of the training degradation family both ways. BI is y = D(x) exactly, so the identity is optimal and our estimator loses 12.84 dB. BD is blur-then-subsample with no noise and no compression: +0.251 dB mean with 2 of 4 clips negative, i.e. noise. A specialist trained on a GUESSED bd chain scored +15.174 dB on its own data and -12.708 dB on Vid4, uniformly across clips, because the guessed chain sits 30.56 dB from D(x) while Vid4 BD sits 38.17 dB away -- a severity mismatch. The operator was then identified from Vid4 GT/BD pairs directly: INTER_AREA subsample, ksize 21, sigma 1.10 reproduces the released frames at 53.392 dB. Retraining on the fitted chain is not done, and the pre-registered check is that the new pairs base must land near 38 dB.
